turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.

I’m sorry it hasn’t arrived. Delivery takes 1 to 2 working days in Romania and 5 to 8 working days in other EU countries. To check your order, please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address used to place it.

rule.ro: Livrarea durează 1–2 zile lucrătoare în România și 5–8 zile lucrătoare în celelalte țări din Uniunea Europeană.
rule.en: Delivery takes 1 to 2 working days in Romania and 5 to 8 working days in other EU countries.

input.summary: Customer says they will file a complaint with ANPC today, contact their bank for a chargeback, and leave a public review. They previously reported that their print has not arrived; order number and email have not been provided, so no order lookup was possible.
